rationale: Any authenticated non-admin could POST /api/profile with is_admin true and make itself administrator; fix limits non-admins to the name field.
Password-reset endpoint returned the reset code in the response; reset-flow logic, not an operation/object/property access decision.
User holding exec or wirelogs grant on one project could exec into or read logs of components owned by other projects, because authorization used the caller-supplied project.
Org member could obtain organization claims in tokens and account API output after admin disabled Organizations; fix gates on realm-level enablement.
Mixed-case host segment made domain suffix match case-sensitive, so a more specific deny/strict rule was skipped and a more permissive later rule applied to the request.
SCIM client could set numeric externalId colliding with internal user ids; fix is only a DB migration, SCIM endpoints and exact request path not shown.
EVM vesting precompile funder check; blockchain precompile call, not an HTTP operation of the service.
Agent holding a valid token for one source could update inventory or agent status of another tenant's source because source_id claim was not compared to the requested id.
CometVisu backend read, write, chart, login, config and fs endpoints were callable by anonymous clients; fix adds role annotations.
Authenticated user in one project could get or delete another project's repository, and get artifacts, by owner/name because lookup was not scoped by project.
Company admin of one virtual instance could view audit events of another instance by supplying its auditEventId; fix compares event company to caller company.
Scoped API token with only projects.background (read) permission could issue DELETE on project background, since route check ignored HTTP method.
Admin with only view-clients role could call evaluate-scopes with arbitrary userId and see user identity and authorization data without view-users rights.

rationale: Authenticated user of one tenant could read durable task event logs of another tenant by task UUID, since the path had no tenant to authorize; fix adds tenant in path and 403 on mismatch.
Authenticated user could obtain presigned image URL for another user's source because ownership check was bypassed; fix returns 403 on username/org mismatch.
Cluster-gateway /api/proxy management API on the externally published listener accepted unauthenticated callers; fix moves it to an internal listener.
